caption:
Anxious heart? Look at what Allah did for Musa's mother

The heart of Musa's mother became so restless that she nearly gave everything away. Allah reassured her heart so she would hold on to her faith in His promise. If your heart is restless today, ask Him to reassure yours.

Surah Al-Qasas 28:10

Which worry will you hand over to Allah today?

#anxiety #prophetmusa #surahqasas #quranreels

Recitation: Abdul Rahman Al-Sudais
alt_text: The heart of Moses’ mother became restless; she was about to disclose it, had We not reassured her heart so that she would maintain her faith [in Allah’s promise] (Surah Al-Qasas 28:10)
theme: anxiety / Allah reassured the heart of Musa's mother
